instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application using a Helm chart from OCI registry
output: argocd app create my-app --repo oci://registry.example.com --helm-chart my-chart --revision 1.0.0 --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application that syncs when a config change is detected
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --sync-policy automated --self-heal

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD to automatically create a namespace when an app is created
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"application.namespaces":"*"}}'

instruction: How to grant a specific user access to a single ArgoCD application
output: argocd proj add-role my-project --name dev-role --policies 'p, proj:my-project:dev-role, applications, sync, my-app, allow'

instruction: How to grant admin access to an ArgoCD project
output: argocd proj add-role my-project --name admin-role --policies 'p, proj:my-project:admin-role, applications, *, allow'

instruction: How to grant read-only access to an ArgoCD project
output: argocd proj add-role my-project --name viewer-role --policies 'p, proj:my-project:viewer-role, applications, get, *, allow'

instruction: How to list the RBAC configuration for a specific project
output: argocd proj get my-project -o json | jq '.spec.roles'
